git commit --no-verify (-n) bypasses all pre-commit hooks including security linters (semgrep, bandit, gosec, trufflehog) — the last automated gate catching AI-generated vulnerabilities (SQLi, hardcoded secrets, weak crypto) before they enter source control. Structural matching requires 'commit' to be git's actual subcommand and -n/--no-verify to belong to that same invocation, eliminating cross-statement FPs from unrelated flags (e.g. a piped `sed -n`) and substring matches on branch names/paths containing "commit".
